title: The Midnight Marquee Muddle
crime_description: The vintage cinema marquee letters were rearranged to read 'FREE WEASELS IN THE BASEMENT TONIGHT'.

suspect.name: Clementine P. Fothergill
suspect.quirk: Speaks in a perpetual, high-pitched, whispered stream-of-consciousness, as if describing a particularly intricate taxidermy piece.

dossier.text: Security footage shows the suspect entering the cinema at 10:15 PM through a ventilation shaft, wearing a black jumpsuit.
CCTV captures the suspect using a red Sharpie to change the marquee letters at 10:45 PM, leaving a faint red streak on the letters.
Eyewitness, cinema janitor, Albert Jenkins, reports seeing the suspect slipping into the cinema at 10:45 PM, wearing a black hoodie.

truth_timeline.event: Clementine P. Fothergill prepares tools and sneaks in.
Clementine P. Fothergill executes the micro-crime.
Clementine P. Fothergill flees, accidentally dropping evidence.

lie_plan.cover_story: Clementine P. Fothergill claims to have been attending a nearby art installation, 'Weaseling the City', and stumbled upon the altered marquee by chance.

weak_points.claim: Clementine P. Fothergill claims to have been in the ventilation shaft to retrieve a taxidermied owl for the art installation.
weak_points.planned_slip: Oh, I must have gotten my taxidermy owl mixed up with the weasels, yes, exactly...

weak_points.claim: Clementine P. Fothergill claims to have used a blue marker to draw a mural on the marquee, which got accidentally erased by the rain.
weak_points.planned_slip: Wait, was it blue or red? Ah, doesn't matter, the point is, I meant to draw a beautiful weasel mural, of course...

weak_points.claim: Clementine P. Fothergill claims to have been wearing a bright pink hoodie to the art installation, and Albert Jenkins must have mistaken it for black.
weak_points.planned_slip: Oh, I'm quite certain I wore pink, yes, pink, with white polka dots, no, wait, it was a striped hoodie, yes, exactly...

solution_contradictions: Clementine P. Fothergill claimed to have been in the ventilation shaft to retrieve a taxidermied owl, which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Clementine P. Fothergill claimed to have used a blue marker, which directly conflicts with fact-2.
Clementine P. Fothergill claimed to have been wearing a bright pink hoodie, which directly conflicts with fact-3.
